title: PerformanceProfileService
responsibility: Measures explicit representative operations and completed source scopes, retaining real latency and honestly labelled whole-process memory.

inputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.beginScope.input
inputs.description: Registered unit and workload, optional callable, and bounded replay settings for the named profiling operation.

inputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.observe.input
inputs.description: Registered unit and workload, optional callable, and bounded replay settings for the named profiling operation.

inputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.observe.operation
inputs.description: Actual operation supplied by the caller; one-pass observers preserve its result, receiver, effects and rejection behavior.

inputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.observeAsync.input
inputs.description: Registered unit and workload, optional callable, and bounded replay settings for the named profiling operation.

inputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.observeAsync.operation
inputs.description: Actual operation supplied by the caller; one-pass observers preserve its result, receiver, effects and rejection behavior.

inputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.measure.input
inputs.description: Registered unit and workload, optional callable, and bounded replay settings for the named profiling operation.

inputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.measure.operation
inputs.description: Representative replay-safe operation executed for the declared warmup, round and iteration counts; errors propagate.

inputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.capture.input
inputs.description: Registered unit and workload, optional callable, and bounded replay settings for the named profiling operation.

inputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.capture.operation
inputs.description: Representative replay-safe operation executed for the declared warmup, round and iteration counts; errors propagate.

outputs.name: profileInput
outputs.description: Strict schema for registered unit/workload identities and bounded rounds, iterations and warmups.

outputs.name: observationInput
outputs.description: Strict metadata schema for one actual unit, workload and optional callable observation.

outputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.peakProcessRssBytes
outputs.description: OS process high-water resident set normalized to bytes for Bun on Darwin and supported Node hosts.

outputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.beginScope
outputs.description: Idempotent callback completing one measured source scope; incomplete scopes do not count as success.

outputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.observe
outputs.description: Exact synchronous operation result; promise identity is preserved without treating an unsettled promise as a completed sample.

outputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.observeAsync
outputs.description: Awaited actual result, recording only successfully completed asynchronous work.

outputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.flush
outputs.description: Current aggregate observations, written through the capture protocol and then removed from the in-memory collector.

outputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.measure
outputs.description: Real latency and process-peak RSS observations after the explicit caller-selected replay and warmup counts.

outputs.name: PerformanceProfileService.capture
outputs.description: Measured observations persisted through Harness captures with a unique immutable chunk name.
